questions.name: Design intent and Functional Requirements
questions.description: Formulation of the user request, and/or what the design needs to do, and/or what is the application, and/or the practical design features that have to be respected.

questions.name: Problem - UII
questions.description: Description of problem(s) encountered in the analysis of user inputs.

questions.name: Solution to Problem - UII
questions.description: Description of the solution(s) adopted for the problem(s).

questions.name: User clarification request
questions.description: Any clarification you wanted to request from the user (e.g. ambiguous inputs, missing information).

questions.name: User images descriptions
questions.description: Your description of any images the user provided this session (what they show, what they imply for the design).

questions.name: User input misinterpretation
questions.description: Any misinterpretation of the content of a specific user image input (parameters read, sketches drawn, features observed) and what should have been done instead.

questions.name: Problem - Planner
questions.description: Description of a problem encountered in the workflow during this session.

questions.name: Problem solution - Planner
questions.description: Description of how the problem(s) you faced were solved this session.

questions.name: Useful learning - Planner
questions.description: Useful learning gathered this session (what worked, what did not, what to avoid next time).

questions.name: Problem - DCIC
questions.description: Problem(s) encountered when creating the input parameters for the Design Configurator this session.

questions.name: Solution to Problem - DCIC
questions.description: Description of the solution(s) adopted for the problem(s).

questions.name: Invalid solution - DCIC
questions.description: Explanation of any invalid change(s) you applied when trying to solve a problem this session.

questions.name: Valid solution - DCIC
questions.description: Explanation of any valid change(s) you applied to solve the problem(s) this session.

questions.name: Problem - DCII
questions.description: Problem(s) encountered when analyzing the input parameters created for the Design Configurator this session.

questions.name: Solution to Problem - DCII
questions.description: Description of the solution(s) adopted for the problem(s).

questions.name: Rejection of inputs - DCII
questions.description: Reason(s) why a set of parameters was REJECTED this session. Mainly interested in the REASON WHY, and examples can be provided.

questions.name: Final Design Output
questions.description: Identify which was the final design output produced this session, that was considered the best match with the user request or that was eventually provided as final design output to the user.

questions.name: Design Output Description
questions.description: A general description of the final design output produced this session — not the feedback, not whether it is correct, just describe the design in general.

questions.name: Design Output Correctness
questions.description: Where the final design output did well: how it satisfied the design intent and the functional requirements, and the absence of problems.

questions.name: Design Output Problems
questions.description: The main problems of the final design output: visible problems, and/or design intent / functional requirements that were not respected.

questions.name: Bad Attempt
questions.description: Identify which was/were the worst design attempt(s) that provided a solution not matching the user requirements.

questions.name: Bad attempt description
questions.description: Description of the unsuccessful design attempt — not the feedback, not whether it is correct, just describe the design in general.

questions.name: Bad Attempt rejection reason
questions.description: Reasons why the attempt was deemed as unsuccessful — visible problems, failures, and/or design intent / functional requirements that were not respected.

questions.name: Bad attempt Suggested solution
questions.description: What solution improved the unsuccessful design, following the user requirements and previous attempts.

questions.name: Useful Attempt insights
questions.description: Identify which was the design attempt(s) that provided a useful insight / learning / piece of information / unexpected result

questions.name: Useful Attempt description
questions.description: A general description of the useful design attempt — not the feedback, not whether it is correct, just describe the design in general.

questions.name: Useful Attempt output observations
questions.description: Observations regarding the design attempt that can be useful to know for similar design attempts.

questions.name: Useful Attempt planner observations
questions.description: Observations regarding the design attempt that can be useful to know when planning the steps or searching a solution to a problem, based on user requirement and expectations.

questions.name: Orchestrator session summary
questions.description: A brief description of what you did this session — how you coordinated the chain, what particular hand-offs you made (that follow non-standard agent chain), any escalations you handled.
